templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms governing how each party uses and protects the other's confidential information. Used together with the Mutual NDA Cover Page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law and signatures; incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement for a provider offering access to a SaaS / cloud product, covering access and use, support, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement defining target uptime, uptime calculation, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement setting out processor/subprocessor relationships, data protection obligations, security and international transfers for personal data processed on a customer's behalf.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement giving an early partner access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement for services delivered under Statements of Work, covering cooperation, deliverables, fees, IP and liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, including feedback, trademark use, confidentiality and liability terms.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA compliance, governing a provider's use, disclosure and safeguarding of protected health information (PHI).

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement granting a customer a license to install and use on-premise software, covering permitted uses, user accounts, fees, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement allowing a customer to access and evaluate a product during a limited pilot period.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum supplementing a main agreement with terms for AI services, including use of inputs and outputs, restrictions and model training.
